 Schools across India will observe winter vacations on different dates during the 2026–27 academic session. Check the expected holiday schedules for Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Jammu and Kashmir.

 Winter Vacation 2026: Check state-wise vacation break dates. Delhi schools to close from Jan 1 to Jan 15, 2027.
 UP and Rajasthan winter breaks begin Dec 31, 2026.
 Jammu and Kashmir offers longer winter break due to cold weather.

 As temperatures begin to fall across several parts of India, students and parents are looking forward to the annual winter break. Schools in different states follow separate vacation schedules depending on local weather conditions and education department guidelines. For the 2026–27 academic session, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Jammu and Kashmir have different winter vacation schedules. Here is a state-wise breakdown of the expected school closure dates and reopening schedules for students. 
 Delhi winter vacation 2026–27 
 According to the Delhi Directorate of Education's school holiday schedule, winter vacation in recognised schools is scheduled from January 1 to January 15, 2027. Schools are expected to resume classes after the break. However, private schools may follow their respective academic calendars, so parents should confirm the dates with their institutions. 
 Uttar Pradesh winter vacation 2026–27 
 Schools in Uttar Pradesh are expected to observe winter holidays from December 31, 2026, to January 14, 2027. The 15-day break will extend into the first two weeks of January, with schools scheduled to reopen on January 15, 2027.

 Rajasthan winter vacation 2026–27 
 In Rajasthan, the winter vacation is scheduled to begin on December 31, 2026, and continue until January 10, 2027. Students are expected to return to classrooms on January 11. The schedule provides a break during the peak winter period in the state. 
 Jammu and Kashmir winter vacation 2026–27 
 Jammu and Kashmir follows a different winter vacation calendar because of its colder weather conditions. According to the academic planner, students in the Foundational, Preparatory and Middle stages are scheduled to receive holidays from December 7, 2026, to February 28, 2027. 
 For Classes 9 to 12, the winter break is listed from December 14, 2026, to February 21, 2027. These dates are subject to formal government orders. 
 What should students and parents know? 
 Winter vacation dates can change depending on weather conditions and government decisions. Schools may also issue separate notices regarding reopening, online classes or revised academic schedules. 
 Parents and students should check official education department announcements and school circulars before making travel or holiday plans. The dates listed above should be treated according to their respective announcement status, particularly where schedules are tentative.
